sys_ui_page.html:
The Intrux Code Search hooks into the OOTB Studio Search by adding a custom remote table which ensures that all application files of the given scope are searched.

In theory the search groups can be used to group searches into relationships like "Client Side", "Server Side", etc. but in practice because scopes are typically smaller and therefore searched very fast, this does not offer a lots of advantages. On top, there is not even a way of changing the search group in the studio. Also, the studio searches tables wether or not they exist for the given scope or not, wasting lot of time.

The Background Search is optimized so that only the tables for the given scope are searched. This is acomplished by iterating over all search handlers to first detect the tables which need to be actually searched in the given hierarchy. Afterwards all tables are searched using the specialized search handler (if it exists). If no specialized handler exists, the fallback handler is used. One exists for application files and one for data - both search all fields on the table, this guarantees there are no blind spots, even for custom configuration tables.

            graph TD
            User[Background Search] --> SH[CodeSearchHandlers]
            SH --> MH[Metadata Handler]
            SH --> FH[Flow Handler]
			SH --> TH[Table Handler]
			TH --> sys_db_object[Tables]
			TH --> sys_dictionary[Fields]
			TH --> sys_choice[Choices]
			TH --> sys_documentation[Labels]
			FH --> sys_hub_flow[Flows]
			FH --> FS[Flow Steps]
			MH --> sys_metadata[Application Files]
